authorized_signatories.description:
Describes authorized signatories.
- Ab1: Company is signed by the board of directors.
- Ab2: Company is signed by the board of director or alternate board of director.
- Ab3: Company is signed by any board of director on his own.
- Ab4: Company is signed by two board of directors together.
- Ab5: Company is signed by the board of directors and alternate board of directors on their own.
- FreeText: If the authorized signatories do not match any of the predefined categories.

status.description:

- ACCEPTED: Orders accepted by us and currently in active processing.
- SENT_TO_BV: Orders that have been sent to and are being processed by Bolagsverket.
- COMPLETED: Orders that are completed and finalized.
- ABORTED: Orders that have been cancelled by us.
- DENIED_BY_BANK: Orders that were denied by the bank.
- UNKNOWN: Returned if an internal status could not be mapped to a known bank-process status. This is not a valid filter value and indicates an unexpected state.

Only visible if caller is authorized to see it (e.g. Integrator X will only see if utm_source is X or 
if utm_source is null, but not if utm_source is Y).

Recurring-API_CreateRecurringDates.description:
Scheduling supplied when creating a recurring. Only `dates` is required.

Supply the first occurrence in `dates` (`invoice_processing_date` and `period_start_date` are required).
`rules` is optional: omit it to accept the defaults (interval 1, frequency MONTH). Anchors (`invoice_anchor`, `period_anchor`) are derived from the
supplied dates when omitted — e.g. `invoice_processing_date` 2026-02-28 with frequency MONTH yields
`invoice_anchor` LAST_DAY. `invoice_date` is computed by the server and is therefore not part of the create input.

Recurring-API_CreateRecurringRule.description:
Defines the billing cadence: how often invoices recur and on which day of each cycle.
`interval` and `frequency` set the cadence; `invoice_anchor` and `period_anchor` set the day within it.

end_date.description: The last date this recurring produces invoices. Omit for an open-ended recurring.

interval.description:
How many `frequency` units between occurrences. Combined with `frequency` this reads as
"every {interval} {frequency}" — e.g. interval 2 with frequency MONTH means every 2 months. Defaults to 1.

Recurring-API_DeviationType.description:
How a deviation alters the targeted invoice occurrence(s):
- ROWS: Replace / extend the invoice's line items with the deviation's rows.
- SKIP: Skip the occurrence entirely; no invoice is generated.

Recurring-API_DiscountType.description:

- AMOUNT: A fixed monetary amount.
- PERCENT: A percentage of the row price.

Recurring-API_DistributionMethod.description:

- EMAIL: Sent as a PDF by email.

Recurring-API_InvoiceHandling.description:
How invoices are produced and managed for the recurring:
- MANUAL: Invoices are created on demand; nothing is generated automatically.
- AUTOMATIC: Invoices are generated automatically on schedule.
- INVOICE_SERVICE_WITH_REMINDERS: Invoices are generated and handled by the Fortnox invoice service, including reminders.
- INVOICE_SERVICE_WITHOUT_REMINDERS: Invoices are generated and handled by the Fortnox invoice service, only invoice creation and delivery without automatic reminders.

Recurring-API_RecurringAnchor.description:
The day of a recurring cycle that an invoice or billing period is anchored to. The valid values depend
on the rule's `frequency`:
- frequency MONTH: DAY_1..DAY_30, or LAST_DAY. LAST_DAY always resolves to the final day of the month,
  clamping for short months (e.g. February 28/29).
- frequency WEEK: MONDAY..SUNDAY.
The anchor must match the rule's `frequency`; a mismatch (e.g. MONDAY with frequency MONTH) is rejected
with `recurring.anchor.not.valid`.

Recurring-API_RecurringDates.description:
The scheduling of a recurring, returned by GET and list endpoints.

It has two parts that always describe the same schedule from two angles:
- `rules`: the cadence you configure — how often invoices recur and on which day of each cycle.
- `dates`: the concrete dates of the next occurrence that result from that rule.

The two are kept in sync server-side: configuring the rule produces the next dates, and supplying
the next dates back-fills the rule's anchors. See `rules.invoice_anchor` / `period_anchor`
for how anchors and dates derive from one another.

- MANUAL: Raised during a manually triggered invoice creation.

Recurring-API_RecurringStatus.description:

- DRAFT: Saved but not yet activated; does not generate invoices.
- ACTIVE: Live; generates invoices according to its schedule (if automatic or invoice service).
- INACTIVE: Paused; retained but not generating invoices.
- FINISHED: Reached its end date; no further invoices will be generated.

Types of tax reduction articles:
- NOT_HOUSEWORK: No tax reduction (0%)
- RUT category (50%): CLEANING, TEXTILE_CLOTHING, SNOWPLOWING, GARDENING, BABYSITTING, OTHER_CARE, MOVING_SERVICES, IT_SERVICES, MAJOR_APPLIANCE_REPAIR, FURNISHING, HOME_MAINTENANCE, TRANSPORTATION_SERVICES, WASHING_AND_CARE_OF_CLOTHING
- ROT category (30%): CONSTRUCTION, ELECTRICITY, GLASS_METAL_WORK, GROUND_DRAINAGE_WORK, MASONRY, PAINTING_WALLPAPERING, HVAC
- GREEN category: SOLAR_CELLS (20%), STORAGE_SELF_PRODUCED_ELECTRICITY (50%), CHARGING_STATION_ELECTRIC_VEHICLE (50%)
- OTHER_COSTS: Other costs (0%) for tax reduction

Recurring-API_TaxReductionCategory.description:
The household/green tax reduction scheme applied to the recurring:
- NONE: No tax reduction.
- RUT: Swedish RUT deduction for household services.

Recurring-API_TaxReductionCostType.description: Indicates if the row represents material costs (MATERIAL) or labor costs (LABOR) for tax reduction calculations

Recurring-API_TextRow.description: A pure text line printed on the invoice that carries no amount. Only `type` and `description` are used. All other fields (`unit`, `account_number`, `vat_percentage`, `quantity`, `price`, `discount`, `article_id`, `discount_type`, `project_id`, `cost_center_id`, `tax_reduction_data`) are ignored and cleared server-side.

description.description: Text describing the row, printed on the invoice. Required for TEXT rows.

row_index.description: Zero-based position of the row within the row list, determining print order.

id.description: Identifier of the existing accrual to update.

rows.description: The accrual distribution rows. Replaces the existing rows.

Recurring-API_UpdateAccrual.description: Full representation of the accrual used when updating. All fields must be supplied; data not sent is cleared.

id.description: Identifier of the existing accrual row to update. Omit to add a new row.

Recurring-API_UpdateAccrualRow.description: Full representation of an accrual distribution row used when updating. All fields must be supplied. Include `id` to update an existing row, or omit it to add a new one.

Recurring-API_UpdateNextDates.description:
The next occurrence's dates. `invoice_processing_date` and `period_start_date` are required.
Changing a date re-derives the matching anchor in `rules`. `invoice_date` is computed
by the server and is therefore not part of the update input.

invoice_processing_date.description: The date the next invoice is generated and processed.

period_start_date.description: The start date of the next billing period.

rows.description: The line items of the recurring. Replaces the existing rows.

tax_reductions.description: Tax reduction records for the recurring, one per applicant. Replaces the existing set.

Recurring-API_UpdateRecurring.description: Full representation of the recurring object. All fields must be supplied. Data not sent is deleted.

id.description: Identifier of the existing row to update. Omit to add a new row.

Recurring-API_UpdateRecurringArticleRow.description: ARTICLE variant of a recurring row on update.

Recurring-API_UpdateRecurringDates.description:
Scheduling supplied when updating a recurring. Both `rules` and `dates` are required.

Anchors and next dates stay in sync: changing the dates in `dates` re-derives the rule's anchors,
and changing the anchors in `rules` re-derives the next dates within the current cycle. If a
date and its anchor are both changed for the same field, the date wins. `invoice_date` is computed by
the server and is not part of the update input.

Recurring-API_UpdateRecurringRow.description: Full representation of a recurring row used when updating. All fields must be supplied; data not sent is cleared. Include `id` to update an existing row, or omit it to add a new one. The `type` discriminator selects the row shape and its per-type field requirements — see UpdateRecurringTextRow, UpdateRecurringArticleRow and UpdateRecurringServiceRow.

Recurring-API_UpdateRecurringRule.description:
Defines the billing cadence: how often invoices recur and on which day of each cycle.
`interval` and `frequency` set the cadence; `invoice_anchor` and `period_anchor` set the day within it.
Changing an anchor here re-derives the matching date in `dates` within the current cycle.

end_date.description: The last date this recurring produces invoices. Omit for an open-ended recurring.

interval.description:
How many `frequency` units between occurrences. Combined with `frequency` this reads as
"every {interval} {frequency}" — e.g. interval 2 with frequency MONTH means every 2 months. Defaults to 1.

id.description: Identifier of the existing row to update. Omit to add a new row.

Recurring-API_UpdateRecurringServiceRow.description: SERVICE variant of a recurring row on update.

id.description: Identifier of the existing row to update. Omit to add a new row.

Recurring-API_UpdateRecurringTextRow.description: TEXT variant of a recurring row on update. Include `id` to update an existing row, or omit it to add a new one.

id.description: Identifier of the existing tax reduction record to update. Omit to add a new one.

Recurring-API_UpdateTaxReduction.description: Full representation of a tax reduction record used when updating. All fields must be supplied. Include `id` to update an existing record, or omit it to add a new one.

Recurring-API_UpdateTaxReductionData.description: Full representation of a row's tax reduction details used when updating. All fields must be supplied; data not sent is cleared.

Recurring-API_VatOption.description: Indicates if the prices are shown including VAT (INCLUSIVE) or excluding VAT (EXCLUSIVE)

Recurring-API_VatPaymentType.description:
The VAT scheme applied to the invoice:
- SEVAT: Swedish domestic VAT.
- SEREVERSEDVAT: Swedish domestic reverse-charge VAT (buyer accounts for VAT).
- EUREVERSEDVAT: Reverse-charge VAT for EU trade (buyer accounts for VAT).
- EUVAT: EU VAT.
- EXPORT: Export outside the EU; no VAT charged.
